continuation_observations.location: Lenin Square and central streets, Khabarovsk
continuation_observations.note: The Insider describes a traditional Furgal-support gathering followed by a march; no turnout estimate is given, and OVD-Info reports at least three detentions. This is before January and does not establish a continuous crowd.
Interfax reports the final Saturday Furgal-support rally of 2020 drew about 30 by the municipal administration’s account; this is below threshold and is not January attendance.
MK describes a traditional Saturday rally with more than 100 by eyewitness estimate.

continuation_observations.location: Khabarovsk; exact site not verified in full body
continuation_observations.note: Conflicting search-result leads: NEWSru title/partial header says several dozen gathered despite a cessation claim; Vedomosti result reports the municipal cessation statement. NEWSru body was only partly captured; Vedomosti returned 404. Not treated as a verified qualifying event.
OpenMedia result title reports another protest, but exact gathering date and turnout were not verified; ordinary request returned HTTP 403.

RFE/RL reports several dozen at a Furgal-support rally, while DW says police prevented people from assembling and detained several people walking across Lenin Square. Turnout/threshold and event ownership remain unresolved; OVD-Info result is blocked. This is not evidence of an uninterrupted physical crowd.

possible_owner_unit: Russia 2020-07 if coded as an older-onset episode; Russia 2021-01 if the Jan. 9 gathering is a separate episode. Ownership pending review.
physical_continuity: An uninterrupted crowd/occupation is not established. December 19 and 26 reports, January weekly actions, and later gatherings are separate observations in a recurring campaign; the Dec. 26 municipal estimate is about 30 and the Jan. 9 report says >100, but breaks/ownership under the unavailable episode rules remain for review.
notes: Vedomosti and Interfax document the July 11, 2020 rally and state-directed demands. MK’s Jan. 9 report describes a traditional Saturday continuation and says weekly actions began after Furgal’s arrest. The Jan. 2 and Jan. 16 observations remain partial or blocked leads. On Jan. 30, RFE/RL and DW conflict on how far a crowd formed. None of these observations establish a continuously assembled crowd or settle whether a January gathering is a distinct episode. The Insider documents a Dec. 19 physical gathering and march but no turnout; Interfax reports about 30 on Dec. 26 by the municipal account. These pre-month observations show recurrence, not uninterrupted physical continuity, and Dec. 26 attendance is not transferred to January.
